title: Цільова активність UAC-0212 у відношенні розробників та постачальників рішень АСУТП з метою здійснення кібератак на об'єкти критичної інфраструктури України (CERT-UA#13702)

entities.name: UAC-0133
entities.gloss: A threat actor cluster tracked by CERT-UA associated with cyberattacks on Ukrainian infrastructure.

entities.name: UAC-0002
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage and sabotage group also known as Sandworm, APT44, or Seashell Blizzard.

entities.name: UAC-0212
entities.gloss: A sub-cluster of UAC-0002 targeting supply chain entities and critical infrastructure in Ukraine and Europe.

entities.name: CVE-2024-38213
entities.gloss: A security feature bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Windows SmartScreen.

entities.name: SECONDBEST
entities.gloss: A malware tool used in cyberespionage campaigns associated with Sandworm.

entities.name: EMPIREPAST
entities.gloss: A malicious payload family deployed by threat actors in cyber operations.

entities.name: SPARK
entities.gloss: A malware tool utilized by threat actors for system compromise.

entities.name: CROOKBAG
entities.gloss: A loader malware written in GoLang used to stage additional malicious tools.

entities.name: PEAKLIGHT
entities.gloss: A malware component deployed in cyberattack delivery chains.

entities.name: RSYNC
entities.gloss: A file copying and synchronization tool abused by threat actors for data exfiltration.

entities.name: Microsoft

entities.name: Strike Ready
